caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral motif composed of various stylized flowers, leaves, and curved stems. The arrangement is largely vertical with the main stem originating from the lower center and branching out into several sections. Prominent colors in the composition include shades of red, pink, yellow, orange, green, and a muted lavender. At the top center is a large, multi-layered central flower with concentric scalloped petals in dark red, pink, yellow, and a central heart-like pink shape. Flanking this central flower on both sides are smaller, circular flowers, each with serrated dark red petals, a white interior, and a multicolor center. Above these are green rounded flowers with circular cutouts, and red foliage with smooth and jagged edges. Beneath the central flower, elongated yellow and orange leaves extend outward and downward. The lower portion of the design includes symmetrical, ornate forms with wavy outlines in pink, red, orange, and lavender, resembling stylized leaves or petals curving downward and outward from the central stem, with additional small red, pink, and orange decorative elements attached. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Design from a Proposed Portfolio
